reason: A transition, duration, easing or delay on an element nothing else sends to the runtime host has no state to tween between, so the static path drops it and reports transition-without-runtime. The runtime records the spec, which a host only reads when a variant or a class value moves a prop.

animate-none clears an animation. The static path omits the spec; the runtime records "none" because a class value resolved at render time has to override a static __velaAnimation, and both hosts treat "none" as no animation.
